// diagnostic

E0361

`{hook}` calls itself through `{symbol}`.

What

`{hook}` calls itself through `{symbol}`.

Why

The symbol inside its own hook dispatches directly back to that hook, so evaluation would recurse forever.

Fix

Combine the value's fields directly, or call a different named helper inside the hook.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0361: tests/ui/operator_recursive_hook.stderr.

Error [E0361]: `add` calls itself through `+`
  --> tests/ui/operator_recursive_hook.jet:8:18
    |
  8 |         first :: self + rhs
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the operator symbol dispatches back to this same hook, so evaluation would recurse forever
 Fix: combine the value's fields or call a different named helper inside the hook
